principle: ZIP ui_kits are product-level references. Each kit must be classified before migration so Flow React templates compose existing foundations, primitives, components, and patterns instead of copying standalone HTML/CSS shells.

kits.requiredDecision: Agent Workspace covers the agent-chat ZIP kit as a product template. ChatThread, ChatMessage, and ChatComposer remain component owners; no standalone chat shell should be copied from the ZIP.
cascadeRisks: custom recovery banner outside Status Feedback View

kits.requiredDecision: Do not introduce an auth page template unless product needs a full branded login surface; keep current OTP/biometric behavior in the governed authentication pattern.
cascadeRisks: brand panel becoming a copied shell

kits.requiredDecision: Keep OTP as authentication pattern behavior; only a product auth template should orchestrate broader brand/page layout.
Use Configuration Console as the canonical admin template.
Use Fleet Dashboard Suite as the canonical multi-dashboard template; dashboard variants are modules, not separate copied templates.
Use Driver Mobile App as the canonical mobile product template.
Keep Fleet Manager Desktop for operating-console flow and Fleet Dashboard Suite for multi-domain dashboards.
Internal Operations Console covers accounts, tickets, cases, pricing, growth, and backoffice ZIP screens; Configuration Console remains the admin/lifecycle template.
cascadeRisks: admin shell duplication with Configuration Console
raw operations table outside owning pattern

kits.requiredDecision: Email remains a separate channel with inline table layout constraints. Email Template Layout owns the base shell and transactional, summary, security, invite, and welcome variants; product React must not absorb these files as app templates.
cascadeRisks: email table layout copied into product React

kits.requiredDecision: The iOS frame is a preview/support wrapper, not a Flow product template. Native platform framing must stay outside React product templates unless a governed platform preview primitive is introduced.
Use Driver Onboarding Mobile for first-use readiness; do not introduce OnboardingCarousel as a component.
cascadeRisks: wizard steps outside Stepper/Multi Step Form

kits.requiredDecision: Use Fleet Manager Onboarding Desktop as pattern inside Fleet Manager Desktop template.
Use Routes and Stations as the canonical routes/station template.
Settings Workspace covers the settings ZIP page as a product workspace; Preference Management remains the behavior owner for groups, form sections, validation, and danger confirmation.
cascadeRisks: theme toggle mutating root outside theme contract
settings controls rendered locally outside Preference Management

kits.requiredDecision: Use Driver Card Wallet as the canonical wallet/card control template.
cascadeRisks: quick actions outside Quick Action component

kits.requiredDecision: Keep vehicle/unit onboarding as Multi Step Form pattern unless it becomes a full admin template module.
